summary: Reviewed 545-585 against the Sanskrit. 27 errors, 87 minor issues. Manual decisions: svānāḥ/svānāsaḥ vs suvānāḥ (548, 555), 563 line 2 subject, 584 avyaḥ. No regrouping suggested; 585 keeps its repeated oṃ line as one unit.
